supersedes: 020/021 diagnostic-only proposals; old task-specific constraints are retained as historical records, not copied into new runtime authority

LOCK.goal: Reusable VK search and publication through Planner commands, registered independent adapter and canonical lifecycle; ordinary publications are data, not new code/deploys
surface: Existing publication card and documented shared Planner adapter command/status
Shared registered consumer; existing job/attempt/lease/fact truth
stagedDelivery: Generic container browser launch and fixture test environment: immutable reviewed executable, chromiumSandbox true, no host execution, no production credentials or session
Data-driven tenant-owned job/package/host resolution, replacing exact business-ID literals with validated records and capabilities; keep historical active jobs immutable and readable
Shared search/image-post/Clip capabilities and canonical result verification, with explicit unsupported/unknown states per format; do not claim native-video readiness from Clip tests
Production discoverability and live UAT only after actually permitted provider checks; no execution activation by this engineering packet
excluded: Any bypass of recorded BrowserUse denial
New queue consumer or production credential activation
Automatic resume/reset/rebind/retry or manual fact creation

security: Non-root Linux amd64 Docker with namespace/seccomp sandbox verified; no no-sandbox/privileged/host-network/docker-socket
No raw tokens/cookies/profile exports/provider payload secrets in source/logs/evidence
No new task/account/channel/revision/package literals or specialized production exports/commands
Two distinct synthetic tenant/job/account datasets execute identical shared code; wrong tenant/revision/hash/manifest fails closed
Every invalid/uncertain case proves no send; receipt/heartbeat/fixture never counts as publication
QAR.acceptance: Focused tests + quality gate + relevant builds + independent review; owner UAT required for full readiness

reuse: Existing scoped Publisher MCP authorization, server principal normalization, provider UI helpers and reconciliation rules
Existing reviewed Docker recipes/shared browser runtime; synthetic DB only
ARCH.runtimeChange: Extract provider-neutral browser-launch configuration/helper with validated executable and explicit sandbox; existing adapter calls helper rather than adding another worker
ARCH.dataBoundary: Resolve requested job with authenticated tenant ownership; derive channel/community/revision/asset/work-item/release hashes and host capability from current owning records, compare immutable snapshot and CAS generation at each side-effect boundary
ARCH.permissionBoundary: Existing actual application authorization remains distinct from recorded external tool restrictions. Neither factory wiring, independent process, config flag nor appnonce clears a real denial. No invented admission/clearance service or permitted=true flag
ARCH.compatibility: No schema migration expected for JSON bindings; if a migration or identity privilege change is found necessary, return exact amendment before applying. Keep existing audit/job/history and legacy reads; no silent old-package rebinding
plannedAreas: Shared VK connector contracts/repository/dispatch/execution ports and existing MCP surface
Shared browser runtime and existing search/Clip/post adapter helpers
Reviewed project container test recipe and acceptance tests

RISK.publicMutation: Excluded until genuine permitted context and exact publication authority exist
RISK.duplicateControl: Existing or started attempt, unknown result or expired lease only reconcile; never resend or infer absence from partial inventory
RISK.tenantControl: Principal normalized server-side, capability+owner checks, resolve records under tenant before provider calls; no default account fallback
RISK.proofLimits: Backend original-photo byte checks do not independently attest host DOM; collection provenance and partial coverage stay explicit
RISK.rollback: Revert additive shared runtime/code to prior release without deleting jobs/facts/leases/profiles/backups; no cutover or config migration in this approval
dependencies: Current browser tests need exact common executable integration and sandbox option
Current task-specific debt requires shared lifecycle refactor, not a task-specific exception
